verses.sanskrit: भीष्म उवाच। तूष्णीमासीदर्जुनस्तु पवनस्त्वब्रवीत्पुनः । शृणु मे ब्राह्मणेष्वेव मुख्यं कर्म जनाधिप ॥१॥
verses.english: Bhishma said Hearing these words of the god of wind, Arjuna remained silent. At this, the god of wind once more addressed him saying, When the dwellers of Heaven, headed by Indra, found themselves within the mouth of the Asura Mada, at that time, Chyavana took away from them the Earth.

verses.sanskrit: मदस्यास्यमनुप्राप्ता यदा सेन्द्रा दिवौकसः । तदैव च्यवनेनेह हृता तेषां वसुन्धरा ॥२॥
उभौ लोकौ हृतौ मत्वा ते देवा दुःखिताऽभवन् । शोकार्ताश्च महात्मानं ब्रह्माणं शरणं ययुः ॥३॥
verses.english: Deprived previously of Heaven and now of the Earth also, the gods became very dispirited. Indeed, those great ones, afflicted with grief, then threw themselves unreservedly upon the Grandfather's protection.

verses.sanskrit: देवा ऊचुः। मदास्यव्यतिषिक्तानामस्माकं लोकपूजित । च्यवनेन हृता भूमिः कपैश्चैव दिवं प्रभो ॥४॥
verses.english: The Gods said O you who are adored by all creatures of the universe, the Earth has been taken away from us by Chyavana, while we have been deprived of Heaven by the Kapas, O powerful one.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मोवाच। गच्छध्वं शरणं विप्रानाशु सेन्द्रा दिवौकसः । प्रसाद्य तानुभौ लोकाववाप्स्यथ यथा पुरा ॥५॥
verses.english: Brahman said You dwellers of Heaven, do you, with Indra, repair speedily and scck the protection of the Brahmanas. By pleasing them you will succeed in regaining both the regions as before.

verses.sanskrit: ते ययुः शरणं विप्रानूचुस्ते कान् जयामहे । इत्युक्तास्ते द्विजान्प्राहुर्जयतेह कपानिति ॥६॥
verses.english: Thus instructed by the Grandfather, the deities went to the Brahmanas and begged for their protection. The Brahmanas replied, enquiring, Whom shall we subjugate? Thus asked, the celestials said to them, Do you subjugate the Kapas.

verses.sanskrit: भूगतान् हि विजेतारो वयमित्यब्रुवन् द्विजाः । ततः कर्म समारब्धं ब्राह्मणैः कपनाशनम् ॥७॥
verses.english: The Brahmanas then said, Bringing them down on the Earth first, we shall quickly subjugate them. After this, the Brahmanas began a rite having for its object the destruction of the Kapas. As soon as this was heard of by the Kapas, they immediately sent a messenger of theirs, named Dhani, to those Brahmanas.

verses.sanskrit: तच्छ्रुत्वा प्रेषितो दूतो ब्राह्मणेभ्यो धनी कपैः। स च तान् ब्राह्मणानह धनी कपवचो यथा ॥८॥
भवद्भिः सदृशाः सर्वे कपाः किमिह वर्तते । सर्वे वेदविदः प्राज्ञाः सर्वे च क्रतुयाजिनः ॥९॥
verses.english: Dhani, coming to them as they sat on the Earth, thus communicated to them the message of the Kapas, The Kapas are like you all. Hence, what will be the results of these rites which it appears you are determined upon?

verses.sanskrit: सर्वे सत्यव्रताश्चैव सर्वे तुल्या महर्षिभिः । श्रीश्चैव रमते तेषु धारयन्ति श्रियं च ते ॥१०॥
verses.english: Of all them are well conversant with the Vedas and gifted with wisdom. All of them care for sacrifices. All of them have Truth for their vow, and for these reasons all of them are considered as equal to great Rishis.

verses.sanskrit: वृथादारान्न गच्छन्ति वृथामांसं न भुञ्जते । दीप्तमग्निं जुह्वते च गुरूणां वचने स्थिताः ॥११॥
verses.english: The goddess of Prosperity sports among them, and they, in their turn, support her with respect. They They never know their wives uselessly, and they never eat the flesh of such animals as have not been killed in sacrifices.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वे च नियतात्मानो बालानां संविभागिनः । उपेत्य शनकैर्यान्ति न सेवन्ति रजस्वलाम् । स्वर्गतिं चैव गच्छन्ति तथैव शुभकर्मिणः ॥१२॥
verses.english: They always proceed on cars and other vehicles together. They never know their wives when the latter are in mcnses. They all act in such a way as to acquire regions of happiness hercafter. Indeed, they are always righteous in their deeds.

verses.sanskrit: अभुक्तवत्सु नाश्नन्ति गर्भिणीवृद्धकादिषु । पूर्वाह्णेषु न दीव्यन्ति दिवा चैव न शेरते ॥१३॥
verses.english: They never cat anything themselves, when enciente women or old men have not caten. They never indulge in play or sports of any kind in the forenoon. They never sleep during the day.

verses.sanskrit: एतैश्चान्यैश्च बहुभिर्गुणैर्युक्तान् कथं कपान् । विजेष्यथ निवर्तध्वं निवृत्तानां सुखं हि वः ॥१४॥
verses.english: When the Kapas have these and many other virtues and qualities, why, indeed, would you seek to subjugate them? You should abstain from the attempt. Indeed, by such abstention you would achieve what is for your good.

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मणा ऊचुः। कपान्वयं विजेष्यामो ये देवास्ते वयं स्मृताः । तस्माद्वध्याः कपाऽस्माकं धनिन् याहि यथाऽऽगतम् ॥१५॥
verses.english: The Brahmanas said Oh, we shail subjugate the Kapas. In this matter, we are quite of a piece with the celestials. Hence, the Kapas deserve to be killed by us. As regards Dhanin, he should return whence he came.

verses.sanskrit: धनी गत्वा कपानाह न वो विप्राः प्रियङ्कराः । गृहीत्वाऽस्त्राण्यतो विप्रान् कपाः सर्वे समाद्रवन् ॥१६॥
verses.english: After this, Dhanin, returning to the Kapas, said to them, The Brahmans are not disposed to do you any good. Hearing this, all the Kapas took up their weapons and went towards the Brahmanas.

verses.sanskrit: समुदग्रध्वजान् दृष्ट्वा कपान् सर्वे द्विजातयः । व्यसृजन् ज्वलितानग्नीन् कपानां प्राणनाशनान् ॥१७॥
verses.english: Seeing the Kapas advancing against them with the standard of their cars upraised, the Brahmanas immediately created certain fires for the destruction of the vital airs of the Kapas.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मसृष्टा हव्यभुजः कपान् हत्वा सनातनाः । नभसीव यथाऽभ्राणि व्यराजन्त नराधिप ॥१८॥
verses.english: Having brought about the destruction of the Kapas, those eternal fires, created with the help of the Vedic Mantras, began to shine in the firmament like so many clouds.

verses.sanskrit: हत्वा वै दानवान् देवाः सर्वे संभूय संयुगे । तेनाभ्यजानन् हि तदा ब्राह्मणैर्निहतान्कपान् ॥१९॥
verses.english: The gods having assembled together in battle, killed many of the Danavas. They did not know at that time that it was the Brahmanas who had encompassed their destruction.

verses.sanskrit: अथागम्य महातेजा नारदोऽकथयद्विभो । यथा हता महाभागैस्तेजसा ब्राह्मणैः कपाः ॥२०॥
verses.english: Then coming there, O king, the highly energetic Narada informed the deities how their enemies, the Kapas, had been really killed by the Brahmanas of mighty cnergy.

verses.sanskrit: नारदस्य वचः श्रुत्वा प्रीताः सर्वे दिवौकसः । प्रशशंसुर्द्विजांश्चापि ब्राह्मणांश्च यशस्विनः ॥२१॥
verses.english: Hearing these words of Narada, the dwellers of Heaven became highly pleased. They also lauded those regenerate and illustrious allies of theirs.

verses.sanskrit: तेषां तेजस्तथा वीर्यं देवानां ववृधे ततः । अवाप्नुवंश्चामरत्वं त्रिषु लोकेषु पूजितम् ॥२२॥
verses.english: The energy and prowess of the celestials then began to increase, and adored in all the worlds, they acquired also the boon of immortality.

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्तवचनं वायुमर्जुनः प्रत्युवाच ह । प्रतिपूज्य महाबाहो यत्तच्छृणु युधिष्ठिर ॥२३॥
verses.english: After the god of wind had said these words, king Arjuna adored him duly and addressing him answered in these words. Hear, O mightyarmed king, what Arjuna said.

verses.sanskrit: अर्जुन उवाच। जीवाम्यहं ब्राह्मणार्थं सर्वथा सततं प्रभो । ब्रह्मण्यो ब्राह्मणेभ्यश्च प्रणमामि च नित्यशः ॥२४॥
verses.english: Arjuna said O powerful god, always and by all means do I live for the Brahmanas. Devoted to them, I adore them always.

verses.sanskrit: दत्तात्रेयप्रसादाच्च मया प्राप्तमिदं बलम् । लोके च परमा कीर्तिर्धर्मश्चाचरितो महान् ॥२५॥
verses.english: Through the favour of Dattatreya I have acquired this might of mine. Through his favour I have been able to perform great feats in the world and acquire high inerit.

verses.sanskrit: अहो ब्राह्मणकर्माणि मया मारुत तत्त्वतः । त्वया प्रोक्तानि कार्त्स्न्येन श्रुतानि प्रयतेन च ॥२६॥
verses.english: Oh, I have with attention, heard the achievements, O god of wind, of the Brahmanas with all their interesting details as described by you truly.

verses.sanskrit: वायुरुवाच । ब्राह्मणान् क्षात्रधर्मेण पालयस्वेन्द्रियाणि च । भृगुभ्यस्ते भयं घोरं तत्तु कालाद्भविष्यति ॥२६॥
verses.english: Oh, I have with attention, heard the achievements, O god of wind, of the Brahmanas with all their interesting details as described by you truly.
